headline: The morning paper lands on the step
lede: Homebody's lot keeps its first hour-scheduled rhythm: every seeded morning the paper boy sweeps past the gate, today's edition flutters onto the path, and one tap sends a resident down to read it for FUN. One paper a day — yesterday's news rots at midnight.

notes.text: HOMEBODY paper route (#2238, PR #2241): hour-scheduled delivery 06:30–08:00, tap-to-read (FUN +0.24, consumes the sheet, content pays), day-stamp once-a-day law, midnight rot, blocked-step fallback, and the attract bot reads it so the demo teaches it.

Fixed a pre-existing freeze: the spoken-word banner faded with a frame-scoped variable, so any banner threw every frame and froze the canvas behind it. The paper banner tripped it in the drive; stepParticles now takes the frame's dt and Homebody's shell is finally lint-clean.

A lane-mate (#2239 visitor choreography) landed in the same files mid-merge — rebased, kept both blocks, and re-ran the full proof: peoplecheck 386/386 (mutants proven twice), homebodydrive 63/63 zero page errors, contractcheck 724/724.
#1711 (PLAICRAFT S1) stayed slot b's by the liveness law; its audit code items shipped via #2243 in another lane — the rest of S1 is now Jon-side (phone takes + key deploy).
